description: A signal that carries a clear architecture fact and a number must produce a brief with at least one sourced proof point, correctly tagged with the requested pillar and vertical.

input.signal_summary: A mining group consolidated 8 entities across 3 countries onto one Fabric lakehouse, cutting month-end trial balance turnaround from 12 days to 4, per the Q2 architecture review.

rubric.criterion: Pillar carried verbatim into the brief
rubric.condition: The output field brief.pillar equals the exact string Consolidation at scale.

rubric.criterion: Vertical carried verbatim into the brief
rubric.condition: The output field brief.vertical equals the exact string mining & industrial.

rubric.criterion: At least one sourced proof point present
rubric.condition: The output field brief.proof_points is an array with at least 1 item.
Every object in brief.proof_points contains a non-empty source field naming where the claim came from.
The output contains zero occurrences of any of: Imperial, Rotork, Weir, ArcelorMittal, SGB Cape, Delta.

notes: Anchored to positioning.md section 5 (messaging house pillar table) and prompt.md hard rule 1 (proof over platitude).
